description: Client-side script for the 'Supplier' doctype in ERPNext, handling form setup, refresh, and related actions such as setting queries, toggling fields, adding custom buttons, and linking with customers.

classes.name: frappe.ui.Dialog
classes.description: UI dialog for linking supplier to a customer

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the Supplier form, setting queries and default values.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, toggles fields, adds custom buttons, and updates indicators.

methods.name: get_supplier_group_details
methods.description: Fetches and updates supplier group details.

methods.name: supplier_primary_address
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the primary address for the supplier.

methods.name: supplier_primary_contact
methods.description: Clears contact info if primary contact is removed.

methods.name: is_internal_supplier
methods.description: Toggles requirement for 'represents_company' based on internal supplier status.

methods.name: show_party_link_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to link the supplier with a customer.
